```lanius
pub fn padding_for(offset:usize,alignment:usize) -> core::result::Result<usize,Error>

Minimum alignment padding for an arbitrary usize offset. Rejects invalid alignment first, then offset or rounded extent above MAX_SIZE, before overflowing arithmetic.

### function: array

pub fn array(element:Layout,count:usize) -> core::result::Result<ArrayLayout,Error>
```

Validates element even when count is zero; stride is padded size and total=stride*count includes the last element padding. Zero stride accepts every usize count; checks multiplication before executing it.

### function: extend

[Source line 75](../../../stdlib/core/layout.lani#L75)

pub fn extend(left:Layout,right:Layout) -> core::result::Result<ExtendedLayout,Error>

Validates left Layout before right, places right after minimum relative alignment padding, and returns offset plus a layout with maximum alignment and no implicit tail padding. Checks complete final rounded validity.
